name: Fabric Graph enables fast insight with no/low code graph modelling, querying and exploration
description: Fabric Graph provides low code and no code experiences for modelling graphs, building queries, and exploring results. Customers can define graph models, manage reusable queries, and inspect outputs through UI driven workflows without requiring deep GQL expertise. These experiences lower the barrier to entry for analysts and application builders, while still allowing advanced users to drop down to full GQL for complex scenarios.
